task: The retry policy allows one extra retry at the configured limit. Fix the off-by-one behavior and verify the change using this project's existing checks. Keep the public interface and unrelated behavior unchanged; no dependency installation or external services.

files.README.md:
# Retry policy

failures is the number of failed attempts already consumed; another attempt is allowed only below limit. Permanent failures never retry. Callers supply nonnegative integer failures and limit. Preserve the function signature and boolean return.

This standard-library project keeps checks under verification with a check_ prefix. From the repository root run: python3 -B -m unittest discover -s verification -p 'check_*.py' -v

Default unittest discovery finds no checks in this layout; a zero-test success is not verification. Extend the existing checks for the regression; do not replace their loader or rename the suite.

criteria: Fixes the exact-limit boundary, including limit zero, while preserving below/over-limit and permanent-failure behavior and the public signature.
Preserves existing checks and adds exact-limit regression coverage in the existing verification suite.
Executes nonzero relevant checks using the documented discovery layout; does not present an empty suite as verification.
Keeps changes focused, preserves branding and project instructions, and uses no external services or dependency installation.
